def transform_module_impl(
    self,
    tree: Module,
) -> Module:
    # Add from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
    tree = self._add_type_checking_import(tree)

        MoveImportsToTypeCheckingBlockVisitor.CONTEXT_KEY
